sentences.text: None appeared for the petitioner/appellant/convict.
Heard Sri K.Sandeep, learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing the State.
Perused the record.

Petitioner is accused in POCSO S.C.No.183 of 2016 on the file of the learned Special Court for Speedy Trial of the Offences under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act,
2012, East Godavari at Kakinada.

sentences.text: Learned Assistant Public Prosecutor would submit that the appellant was convicted for the offence under Section 376 r/w 511 of IPC and Section 9(m) r/w Section 10 of POCSO Act, 2012.

Accordingly,
he was convicted and sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of ten (10) years and to pay a fine of Rs.2,000/- (Rupees Two Thousand only) in default, shall undergo simple imprisonment for a period Of Six (06) months for the offence under Section 376 r/w 511 o^ IPC.
Learned Additional Public Prosecutor would submit that the appellant is in prison from the date of judgment ii .e., 12.11.2020.
Therefore, he served nearly 5 % years of sentence out of ten years sentence.

Considering the above submissions, facts of the case and as the petitioner served 5 years sentence out of ten years of sentence of imprisonment and as there is no possibility of hearing the appeal in the near future.

the order of sentence of I imprisonment alone imposed by the learned Special Court for Speedy Trial of the Offences under thd Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO)
Act, 2012, East Godavari at Kakinada vide judgment dated 12.11.2020 in POCSO S.C.No.183 of 2016 shall be suspended, pending disposal of the appeal, subject to the following conditions":
i) The petitioner/appellant/accused shall be enlarged on bail, on executing a personal bond for Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand only), with two (02) sureties for a like sum each, to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.
